name: Drift
description: The square gradually rounds and travels off-center. A drifting aperture gives the familiar contour field a different balance.

name: Counterturn
description: The frames rotate forward, then reverse as they contract. This creates a denser folded edge around a quiet rounded opening.

name: Confluence
description: Quarter-circle tiles form two solid circular groups and two open ones. Positive and negative shapes balance across the same precise grid.

name: Relay
description: Convex and concave tiles pass a curve through the grid. Alternating solid and open cells create a more directional composition.
